name: To Be Continued!
original_name: とぅびぃこんてぃにゅーど！
source:
Azusa Ueno, a high school girl, lives an ordinary life.
One day she calls herself a "drama talent producer".
A mysterious woman called Kiriko appears.

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22689]Freem![/url]]
translation:
女高中生上野梓过着平凡的生活。
有一天，她称自己为“戏剧天才制片人”。
一位名叫切子的神秘女子出现了。

[来自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22689]Freem！[/url]]
